inference.bp_diagnostics: equal-active-day condition-minus-control raw and beta-residual basis-point means with Bartlett HAC(5) inference
inference.distribution: linear-interpolated active-day quantiles of daily shared delta-z; positive means strictly greater than zero

hac.lag_unit: ordered active sessions after null removal
hac.p_value: two-sided asymptotic normal for the HAC t-statistic

inference.joint_holm: one fixed 24-test family over direction by candidate full-period shared HAC p-values; Holm step-down under arbitrary dependence

matched_metrics.stock_time_equal: runner-provided equal-stock, equal-time-bucket condition-minus-pool daily z

inference.pooled_effect: condition and control rows pooled only over sessions where both cohorts have z-valid observations
inference.primary_estimand: daily condition mean z minus the same-day complete shared eligible-pool mean z
inference.within_direction_bh: separate 12-candidate full-period BH families for short and long shared HAC tests, computed by the common reporter

candidate_definitions.fh_neg_absorption: fresh trigger, depth ratio <= -8, <= 1.5 ticks below high, and bullish 2-of-3 tick-feature score
candidate_definitions.fh_neg_depth8: fresh trigger and F_high / prior top depth <= -8
candidate_definitions.fh_neg_far: fresh trigger, F_high < 0, and >= 4 ticks below high
candidate_definitions.fh_neg_near: fresh trigger, F_high < 0, and <= 1.5 ticks below high
candidate_definitions.fh_neg_rejection: fresh trigger, depth ratio <= -8, >= 4 ticks below high, and bearish 2-of-3 tick-feature score
candidate_definitions.fh_pos_breakout: fresh trigger, depth ratio >= 2, <= 1.5 ticks below high, and bullish 2-of-3 tick-feature score
candidate_definitions.fh_pos_depth2: fresh trigger and F_high / prior top depth >= 2
candidate_definitions.fh_pos_exhaustion: fresh trigger, depth ratio >= 2, <= 1.5 ticks below high, and bearish 2-of-3 tick-feature score
candidate_definitions.fh_pos_far: fresh trigger, F_high > 0, and >= 4 ticks below high
candidate_definitions.fh_pos_near: fresh trigger, F_high > 0, and <= 1.5 ticks below high
